nom: Origins Youthtopia Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report gentle exfoliation without breakouts or added damage.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry, report no stinging or irritation and describe hydrated, dewy, smoother skin, though some limit use to twice a week or every few days.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the peel feels rejuvenating and effective without harshness, with one long-time Origins user noting brighter, smoother skin after a week.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no irritation, stinging, dryness, or breakouts, with several surprised at how well it was tolerated.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 50s reports plumper-looking skin and less visible wrinkles the morning after use, preferring it over her retinol cream; another with combination-to-dry mature skin reports softer, more even-toned skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report fine lines and wrinkles appearing less visible, skin looking plumper and firmer the next morning, and improved texture and tone over weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the peel leaves skin hydrated, dewy, or plumped rather than dried out; one expected the typical dryness of liquid exfoliants and did not experience it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports fading redness with continued use; several with reactive or sensitive skin report no redness or irritation at all, though one first-time user noted temporary pinkness after application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically reports her skin barrier felt intact after weeks of use with no dryness or bad reactions.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation reports a noticeably more even, clearer complexion; others note reduced dullness and more even skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report gentle exfoliation without new breakouts and clearer-looking pores; no reviewer describes new blemishes from use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the peel removes excess dirt and oil from the face, and another notes it clears sebaceous filaments for smoother makeup application in the T-zone.

aspects.libelle: Bottle design causes spills, no dispenser

extraits.texte: I was really excited about this product and enjoy the face cream in this line, but this product has a distressing smell. It gave me a headache it was so strong. I hope they can reproduce without the artificial fragrance, because I would love to give this product a proper try.

I have really liked this product so far. It's not too harsh and as someone with oily and acne prone skin I have been searching for a good peel. It smells quite lovely and not like strong chemicals. This review was Incentivized.

extraits.titre: This appears to make a true difference in my skincare
extraits.texte: I am 54 and enjoy hiking and a natural look for beauty and skincare. I've been applying this product in the evening after cleansing with "Checks and Balances" wash. After that I have been going back and forth between a light retinol cream or a basic simple cream moisturizer, or sometimes the Origins ginger line of creams. Anyway it seems to me that this Youthtopia actually makes a big difference for how my skin looks the next morning. Regardless of which cream I use, the main difference seems to be this. What I see is healthier skin because it looks less tired and more hydrated. Hard to say "plump" but to me that means my deeper 50 year old wrinkles are less visible and my overall look is refreshed. When I apply this, I feel nothing and there is no immediate change. But the next morning, day after day, I can see a benefit. I know they are not the same thing but if I had to choose between my retinol cream and Youthtopia, I would keep my Youthtopia. Now that some time has gone by, I am interested in trying the other products similar to this one.

I've been using this product and so far I'm really liking it. My skin is oily and tends to break out in acne easily, but this product has exfoliated gently without causing any damage. My skin feels radiant, and I'm enjoying it.

I was really impressed by this exfoliant. I have dry skin so I limit my chemical exfoliant use to about twice a week. I used this in the evening, after cleansing and toning but before my moisturizer. I applied with a cotton round. I did not find this product irritating or harsh at all. My skin actually looked very dewy after applying and felt hydrated. It contains so many great ingredients and I love that the formulation is vegan. It does have a strong scent—apple, of course—but I really liked it. I found it refreshing! I would definitely recommend this one!

The confidence boost from achieving a smoother, even complexion is PRICELESS! The formulation has been amazing! I have sensitive skin, and the product never once caused irritation, and it doesn't feel dry or tight on my skin.I saw a visible reduction in the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and my skin texture has been improving the more I use it. My skin also looks very radiant and glowing . Very happy with the results !

This Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel works wonders for my combination to dry and mature skin. I love how gentle it is for my skin. It does not cause any dryness or irritation. I apply it onto my skin with a cotton pad and since using this peel my skin is feeling softer and smoother. The texture of my skin has improved, and my skin tone is more even. A wonderful peel that I have added to my skincare routine!
